title: Diffeologies on Locally Convex Spaces and Smooth Multiplication of Distributions
summary: We investigate the canonical and $c^\infty$-diffeologies on Hausdorff locally convex spaces and their applications to Schwartz distributions. We prove that a Hausdorff locally convex space, endowed with its canonical diffeology, is convenient if and only if the canonical map to its internal tangent space at each point is a linear isomorphism. This yields a geometric characterization of Mackey completeness.
